about: The test matrix: each question with the traces it is asked of and the right answer on each. Generated by make_pairs.py. Never give this file to the systems under test: it names each trace's fault. Remapped on 2026-11-20 from the earlier recording's picks to the re-recorded runs (same program, fault and events left out), so the matrix is the same as before. On 2026-11-21, Q2 (busy_wait) on the busy_wait and cpu_hog traces became cannot_see (make_pairs.UNSEEABLE): a spin-wait and nonstop computation look the same in a kernel trace.
